Recover inter-block information (REML)

Source: R/recovery.R
recover_interblock.Rd

In incomplete block designs (alpha, lattice, BIBD, cyclic, augmented), the intra-block analysis of design_anova() treats blocks as fixed and uses only comparisons within blocks. When blocks are random, block totals also carry information on the treatments. This function fits blocks as a random effect, estimates the block and error variances by restricted maximum likelihood (REML) and returns the treatment means as generalised least-squares estimates (BLUEs), with their standard errors and the efficiency gained over the intra-block analysis and over a complete block design.

Usage

recover_interblock(fit)

Arguments

fit

An "ad_anova" object of an incomplete block design (designs "ibd", "bib", "augmented", "rcbd" with incomplete blocks).

Value

An object of class "ad_recovery" with the variance components (sigma2_block, sigma2), the adjusted treatment means and SEs (means), the average standard error of a difference for the combined, intra-block and complete-block analyses, and the REML log-likelihood.

Examples

lay <- make_design("alpha", trt = 12, r = 3, k = 3, seed = 4)
b <- field_book(lay, "Yield")
b$Yield <- 10 + as.integer(factor(b$Treatment)) / 5 + rep(c(-1, 0, 1), length.out = nrow(b))
fit <- design_anova(b, "Yield", "Treatment", block = c("Block", "IncBlock"))
recover_interblock(fit)
#> 
#> Recovery of inter-block information (REML)
#> Incomplete block design (lattice, alpha, BIBD), intra-block analysis
#> Variance components: blocks = 0, error = 0.7576 (block variance on the boundary: no inter-block information)
#> Average SE of a difference: combined 0.7107, intra-block 1.044, replicates as complete blocks 0.7107
#> Relative efficiency of the combined analysis: 215.7 % of the intra-block analysis, 100.0 % of complete blocks
#> 
#>  level n  mean     se intra_mean
#>    T11 3 10.27 0.5025     10.378
#>     T4 3 11.07 0.5025     11.254
#>     T6 3 12.13 0.5025     12.012
#>     T5 3 10.93 0.5025     10.704
#>    T10 3 10.73 0.5025     10.714
#>     T1 3 10.87 0.5025     11.162
#>     T3 3 11.53 0.5025     11.696
#>     T9 3 12.40 0.5025     12.629
#>    T12 3 11.47 0.5025     11.730
#>     T7 3 11.67 0.5025     11.479
#>     T2 3 10.33 0.5025      9.895
